projects.title: Loom
projects.summary: Turns one goal into a task graph that planner, worker and validator agents run together.
points: Designed a planner, worker and validator agent loop: the planner turns one goal into a schema-validated task DAG, workers run independent nodes in parallel, and validators drive revisions, with Temporal crash recovery.
Built an event pipeline from Redis through Kafka and a Go service to gRPC and WebSocket clients, with per-run sequence numbers so a reconnecting client never applies an event twice.
Wrote a non-blocking Go fan-out hub that evicts slow subscribers instead of stalling the Kafka consumer, verified under the race detector.
Exposed runs to AI clients such as Claude Code through a read-only, account-scoped MCP server.

projects.title: ChatFlow
projects.summary: A typed real-time chat backend, load-tested to 5,000 concurrent sockets with zero message loss.
points: Load-tested with k6 to 5,000 concurrent sockets and ~97k deliveries/s with zero message loss on one Node process (p95 40 ms at 1k sockets), and traced the ceiling to the single-threaded broadcast loop.
Designed a typed Socket.IO event contract with Zod validation on every payload, JWT socket auth, scrypt hashing and tiered rate limits, covered by 32 integration tests in GitHub Actions.

projects.title: SoilSense
projects.role: Backend Engineer, faculty-mentored AgriTech startup (BIT Mesra)
projects.summary: A crop-suitability engine that maps each soil deficiency to an organic amendment.
points: Built the crop-suitability rules engine (FastAPI) across 22 crops on a public 2,200-sample dataset, using tolerance bands of 10% on NPK and 0.3 on pH to map each soil deficiency to an organic amendment.
Combined 22 per-crop API calls into one batched endpoint on a pre-loaded dataset: 2.3x faster (48 to 21 ms).
Validated and type-cast the 5 sensor inputs before they reach the Gemini prompt, rejecting any unexpected fields.

projects.title: Open Source: Oppia & FOSSology

points: Promoted to Collaborator with merge access on Oppia's Dev Workflow team (6.8k stars), after 3 merged PRs.

Migrated FOSSology's Vagrant dev environment from end-of-life Ubuntu 20.04 to 22.04 to match its CI runners.

projects.title: Comment Moderation NLP
projects.summary: A 4-class comment-moderation classifier reaching 0.836 macro-F1 on 198k comments.
points: Built a comment-moderation classifier on 198k comments using TF-IDF plus 36 engineered signals.
A LightGBM and Logistic Regression blend reached 0.836 macro-F1 and lifted the rare threat class from 0.23 to 0.65 F1.

projects.title: CollegePredictor
projects.summary: Enter a JEE rank and get NITs, IIITs and GFTIs banded by how likely each one is.
points: Built a Playwright ETL that scrapes the official ASP.NET counselling archive into PostgreSQL.
Bands results with a four-level confidence model (SAFE, LIKELY, DREAM, REACH) using batched cross-year lookups, with 34 tests in CI.

projects.title: Co
projects.summary: A durable runtime being built so an AI agent can plan, implement, test and ship changes to itself.
points: Phase 1 of 5 is complete: the database layer, typed repositories and health API.
Every async function returns a typed Effect, with dependency injection through Effect Layers so tests can swap in a test database.

projects.title: Gmail Mail Parser
projects.summary: Groups a Gmail inbox by sender and finds unsubscribe links, all processed locally.
points: Connects through Google's OAuth2 and shows inbox statistics, emails grouped by sender and an unsubscribe manager.
All processing happens on the user's own machine.

projects.title: Job Tracker

points: Built as an npm-workspaces monorepo with a Next.js client and an Express REST API on PostgreSQL.
